Learning, not a scripted animation.

The agent tries actions, collects rewards, and updates its neural network. It starts with no balancing knowledge.

How the experiment works

Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) learns a policy for pushing left or right. An episode ends at 12° of tilt, 2.4 m from center, or 500 steps. The live view tests the latest policy; the graph shows real training rewards. Dragging freezes that policy at its current update. Release the cart to let the agent respond, then resume learning when you are ready.

Learning speed changes simulated steps per second, not the size of the learning updates.
